# Purpose

This example application teaches a newcomer how its Convert example action reaches the Click operation.

## Getting started

Open the main window and select Convert example to follow the captured event into its Pascal handler.

## Main source units

| Unit | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `Main.pas` | First screen and action |
| `Worker.pas` | Background operation |

- Open the first screen.
- Follow the **Convert** action.

1. Select the example input.
2. Check the displayed result.
